verdict.rationale: The Development/Agents view (foreloop-docs-8) shows one row per worker listing which agent it's running as, its checkout name, current task, and 'the last thing it said' — providing a status snapshot, and mobile approval (foreloop-docs-20) implies some live visibility. However, there's no evidence of a true real-time streaming view of an agent's live actions/logs as it works, only periodic status polling ('checks on a cadence' per foreloop-docs-37). Missing for 10: explicit real-time/live activity feed or log streaming, refresh-rate/latency details, and independent confirmation the dashboard updates live rather than on task-completion snapshots.
